theft.title: A PC of a technician is stolen
theft.step1: Suspend the station (one click, no second factor): it can no longer act.
theft.step2: Revoke it: its unused tokens are revoked, its open provisionings abandoned, its session closed.
theft.step3: Review the devices this station enrolled since the theft, and put the doubtful ones in identity quarantine.
theft.step4: The renewed station creates a new ADB key: the old authorisation expires on Android 11 and later after 7 days; on Android 7 to 9, revoke the USB debugging authorisations at the next visit.
